cefrAlignment: Matches the B1 descriptors for writing personal and routine work notes and emails that give information and ask for action.
examFidelity: TOEIC Respond to a written request (two emails, 10 minutes each, 'give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question'-style directions) and TOEFL Write an Email (7 minutes, request / information / solution) agree with exams.ts.
fixes: ex2 text: 'lunch is ordered for six people' changed to the more natural 'lunch has been ordered for six people'.
ex2 gap 5: added 'Warm' and 'Many' as accepted words before 'regards'.
openConcerns: Some overlap with lessons 3 and 5 (email tone and TOEIC reply tips). Here it is applied to workplace updates, so it is acceptable.
learnerOutcome: A learner can write short, well-organised work emails and updates that put the main point first and answer every request within exam time limits.
